mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months where PAYEMS exceeds 150.0k, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential investment (HOUST) below 450k units signals weakening housing demand, which triggers a contraction in construction-related spending and reduces near-term economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 450.0k, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a broad-based supply-side contraction and labor market deterioration, reducing corporate profitability and investor confidence, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 370k million dollars signals a collapse in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenues and triggers a bearish equity market reaction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls below 370k, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 225.0 with a concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS signals disinflationary pressures and an active monetary easing cycle, which increases equity risk appetite and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL > 225.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 93.0 with a concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 9.0 signals a deepening supply-side contraction and labor market stress, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 93.0 and UNRATE > 9.0, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
